verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents Rovo AI or any Jira feature drafting a project or initiative status update from recent activity. The nearest claims are about adjacent features: AI-built automations and reminders that keep issue status current, AI-assisted progress tracking from other tools, and trend identification. None of these generate a written status update, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI draft a project or initiative status update from recent activity
